text.label: Heading: It works on anything. That's why we're showing it to you.
text.value: It works on anything. That's why we're showing it to you.

text.label: Text: You are a coach, an author or an influencer, and this page s
text.value: You are a coach, an author or an influencer, and this page shows you a truck bed builder, a pet wash and a firewood company. You are right to wonder what any of that has to do with you. The answer is the reason this page exists, so let me explain it here.

text.label: Text: Every website has one job.
Text: A stranger shows up. They need to understand who you are and
text.value: A stranger shows up. They need to understand who you are and what you do without having to work for it. Then they need one clear next step. That is the whole job, and it does not change with what is being sold. A dog groomer needs it. A realtor needs it. A coach with 10,000 followers needs it more than either of them, because your stranger arrives off a clip, curious for about a minute, and leaves if the page does not meet them.

text.label: Text: Why these are so different.
Text: If we showed you eight coaching websites, you would judge th
text.value: If we showed you eight coaching websites, you would judge the coaching. You would compare their programs to yours and miss the point. So we show you businesses that have nothing in common with each other. Truck beds, paint correction, landscape design, water filtration, home repairs, real estate. When the work is that different and the result still holds up, the only thing left to look at is the build. That is what you would be buying from us.

text.label: Text: Open one on your phone.
Text: Start there, because that is where your audience lives. Some
text.value: Start there, because that is where your audience lives. Somebody watches a clip of you, taps your name and lands on your website with the phone still in their hand. Notice how the page fills the screen. Notice whether you have to pinch, zoom or hunt for anything. Most websites were built for a desk and squeezed onto a phone afterward. Yours will be built for the phone first, because that is how a follower will meet you.

text.label: Text: Before you scroll at all, ask yourself two things. Do I know
text.value: Before you scroll at all, ask yourself two things. Do I know what this business does? Do I know who it is for? If the answer is yes, the page has done the hardest part of its job. Now picture your own name up there, with what you teach said that plainly. Most people in your position have never had one place online that says it straight. They have a profile, a link and a hope.

text.label: Text: Look for the next step.
Text: Look at what each of these pages asks the visitor to do, and
text.value: Look at what each of these pages asks the visitor to do, and how easy it is to find. A follower who has to guess what to do next does nothing, and they do not come back to try again. On your website that step is buying what you know or getting on your calendar. The demos show you how plain it should be. Nobody should need directions to give you money.

text.label: Text: Notice how each one is made to look like the business it bel
text.value: Notice how each one is made to look like the business it belongs to. Yours will work the same way. It will look and sound like you, with your face, your story and your words on it. We do the building. The visitor only ever sees you.

text.label: Text: Here is why I want you to open them instead of taking my wor
text.value: Here is why I want you to open them instead of taking my word for it. The social platforms are borrowed ground. Your website is the one place every clip, every episode and every mention of your name can send people, and the one place that is yours. These eight are what that place looks like when it is built right. Open two or three. Then come back, because for you the website is only where it starts.

text.label: Heading: For you, the website is only the front door.
text.value: For you, the website is only the front door.

text.label: Text: Everything above is the first of six systems. For a local bu
text.value: Everything above is the first of six systems. For a local business, that page sells a service: a clean truck, a repaired fence, a house. Yours has a different job, because you are not selling a service somebody can look up. You are selling what you know. So your website carries two things those demos do not, and it sits in front of something they do not show at all.

text.label: Text: Most people with an audience have never sat down and turned
text.value: Most people with an audience have never sat down and turned what they know into something a person can buy. It stays in their head, in their videos and in their answers to messages. My team and I pull it out and package it into your own e-book, with your name on the cover, sold on your website. Now a follower who likes you has a way to pay you without waiting for you to answer them personally.

text.label: Text: We produce it and it lives on your website, just like mine d
text.value: We produce it and it lives on your website, just like mine does. Here is why it matters. People need to see you and hear from you seven to ten times before they trust you enough to pay. A podcast is how they spend real time with you, in their car and in their kitchen, over and over. You talk about what you know. We handle the technical work that stops most people from ever starting one.

text.label: Text: That is a talent agency.
Text: Packaging what you know and getting you seen and heard is wh
text.value: Packaging what you know and getting you seen and heard is what a talent agent has always done. My team and I are a modern day talent agency. Talent used to need radio, TV and a gatekeeper, and most people could not even get into that space. Free social media and a podcast that is practically free flipped that. Anybody can be seen now. What you still need is somebody behind you who teaches you self-promotion and shows you how to sell what you know with a modern website and a sales system. Every business in the demos above has to promote itself to make it. So do you.

text.label: Text: That sales system has a name. Behind the website sit the oth
text.value: That sales system has a name. Behind the website sit the other five systems, connected to it and to each other. The content engine turns one recording from you into videos, clips and episodes everywhere, all pointing home. Speed to Lead answers every comment and message in seconds. Reviews ask every client and reader for a testimonial. Database Reactivation goes back to everyone who went quiet, which is where the cross-sells and upsells live. Paid ads come last, once the free attention is already turning into buyers.

text.label: Text: AI employees do, day and night. They answer, follow up, ask
text.value: AI employees do, day and night. They answer, follow up, ask for the testimonial and go back to the people who drifted off. That is the part no person can keep up with for every follower, and it is the reason this was only possible for big companies until now. Behind those AI employees is my team, and I am personally on your account. You are not handed a login and wished good luck.

text.label: Text: You keep doing the thing that built your audience. You show
text.value: You keep doing the thing that built your audience. You show up and talk about what you know. You sit down with us so we can get it out of your head and into the e-book. You record. We build the website, package the product, produce the podcast and connect the six systems. When a buyer is ready to talk, that conversation lands on your calendar. The rest of it runs without you chasing it.

text.label: Text: Look around the website you are on right now. A book for sal
text.value: Look around the website you are on right now. A book for sale. A podcast. Six systems behind the page, sorting, sifting and funneling people from the first time they see me to the day they pay. That is the prototype. What a client gets is that same business model, front to back, with their name on it instead of mine. I do not see anybody else offering that. The demos above prove the build travels. This website shows you the whole thing running.

text.label: Text: I will be straight with you. If having your own podcast and
text.value: I will be straight with you. If having your own podcast and your own product scares you, we are not the right fit, and it is better you know that now. If you read this and thought, that is the piece I have been missing, then the next step is the application on the home page. Every client starts with a conversation, and we only take on a few at a time.
